Class Memory

java.lang.Object
threepl.exec.Var
threepl.exec.Memory
All Implemented Interfaces:
TDEConstants, Constant
public final class Memory extends Var implements Constant, TDEConstants
This class represents a CMEMORY or RMEMORY variable. If the variable is a module, procedure or function parameter it may have an indirect pointer to another Var, depending on its mode and whether input or output. It also has an expanded name to ensure that this instance is unique. The following special cases apply -
  • If isInPar is true then this variable is a module, procedure or function input parameter.
  • If isOutPar is true then this variable is a module or procedure output parameter.

    • Memory

      public Memory(Ident ident, boolean registered, int ports, Type dtype, Type atype, boolean in_par, boolean out_par, Val init, Val init0, Val init1, SrcLoc loc)
      Construct a CMEMORY or RMEMORY mode variable.
      Parameters:
      ident - is the memory identifier
      registered - is true if the RAM output is registered
      ports - is the number of ports
      dtype - is the input and output data type
      atype - is the address type
      in_par - is true if this is a module, procedure of function input parameter
      out_par - is true if this is a module or procedure output parameter
      init - is a compound initialisation value
      init0 - is the initial value of output register port 0 (rmemory only)
      init1 - is the initial value of output register port 1 (rmemory only)
      loc - is the source file location
